subject: Post-call: Executive sponsor recap — outcomes, risks, procurement path
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthprime.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Executive sponsor recap — outcomes, risks, procurement path

Hi Elena (and team),

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our exec-level conversation so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps for procurement and legal. I tried to be concise — please flag anything I missed.

High-level business outcomes we discussed:
- Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by ~40% vs your current setup (goal: cost parity with existing batch jobs).
- Achieve 99th-percentile response latency < 450ms for your peak clinical inference flows.
- Keep PHI and audit logs resident in us-west-2 for the pilot (data residency requirement).

Top pain points called out by your team:
- Unpredictable tails during concurrent batch/real-time traffic (sporadic 2–3s spikes).
- Lack of predictable pricing when scaling to hundreds of concurrent sessions.
- Compliance evidence (SOC2 + retention controls) required for pilot approval.

Procurement path / gating items we agreed on:
1) Initial pilot (6–12 weeks) using Redwood Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) — healthprime signs MSA + SOW specifying pilot SLAs and data residency.
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 summary delivered to HealthPrime legal (we offered SOC2 report extract and architecture notes).
3) Tech validation: 2-week focused performance run with your sample traffic and our observability hooks enabled.
4) Commercials: pilot pricing (monthly commit) -> production commit conversation after pilot metric review.

Escalation and risk items to monitor:
- SLA exception for very large batch windows; agreed fallback: auto-route to a lower-cost model variant during demand spikes.
- If we cannot meet the 99th percentile target in the performance run, we escalate to the runtime engineering lead and consider dedicated kernel / quantization trial.

Immediate next steps (owner / target date):
- Rachel: Send SOC2 summary + MAP (mutual action plan) draft by Mon 9/21.
- Lauren: Loop in legal and send a first-pass MSA redline template to HealthPrime legal by Tue 9/22.
- Jonas: Prepare a perf-benchmark checklist and sample-run plan by Wed 9/23.
- Elena: Confirm pilot headcount (eng + security approvers) and whether HealthPrime needs an on-prem option for the pilot (reply by Mon 9/21).

Attachments referenced: SOC2_summary_2026.pdf (summary, not full report), HealthPrime_MAP_v1.docx (draft mutual action plan).

If this looks right, I'll send the MAP and SOC2 extract immediately and we can lock meeting slots for the technical validation run.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena@healthprime.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HealthPrime Legal <legal@healthprime.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive sponsor recap — outcomes, risks, procurement path

Rachel — thanks for the clear notes. This lines up with our internal view. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pilot scope: we want the perf run to include the clinical inference pipeline (transform+inference+post-process) with a sample of 20k requests/day and a 10% burst pattern. Can you confirm Redwood can simulate that load?
- Data residency: must remain in us-west-2 for the pilot; we will consider VPC-only if the perf run shows data leakage concerns.
- Legal: we will review the MAP and SOC2 extract and revert with a short list of redlines. Our preferred timetable is to have a fully executed SOW before Oct 15.

Regarding credits: can Redwood allocate a one-month pilot credit to offset hosting costs while we run validation? That will help our finance team move faster.

I'll confirm the pilot approvers (security + infra) by EOD Tue.

—Elena
Elena Morales
VP Product & Partnerships | HealthPrime
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: HealthPrime Legal <legal@healthprime.com>, Elena Morales <elena@healthprime.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive sponsor recap — outcomes, risks, procurement path

Thanks Elena — welcome aboard. Quick read on our side:

- We can schedule a short legal-to-legal call to walk through the MAP and pilot SOW. I'll propose windows for Wed/Thu.
- On credits: we have a pilot credit program. Rachel, can you confirm recommended credit amount for the 6–12 week run and we can include that in the MAP?
- On the MSA: HealthPrime's note about an on-prem option is fine to include as an exhibit; we'll mark it as optional pending the perf validation.

Jonas — when you share the perf checklist, please call out the exact sample payload sizes and required artifact types (nvprof logs, 95/99 latency distributions, token-count distribution). We'll need those to produce an apples-to-apples report for HealthPrime.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthprime.com>, HealthPrime Legal <legal@healthprime.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive sponsor recap — outcomes, risks, procurement path

Elena — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming items I just uploaded and shared to the HealthPrime folder (Drive link below):

- SOC2_summary_2026.pdf (architectural summary + control mapping)
- HealthPrime_MAP_v1.docx (mutual action plan with owners and dates)
- Pilot-credit proposal: Redwood offers $30k in pilot credits applied against dedicated capacity (we can revise based on estimated run consumption).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-HealthPrime-Pilot (HealthPrime members only)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HP-4521

Next internal tasks: Jonas will stand up the perf harness and share a sample-run RSVP for the week of 9/27. Lauren will propose the legal call times. I'll follow up with a calendar invite once times are confirmed.

If HealthPrime approves, we should have a signed SOW before Oct 15 to keep the pilot start in early Oct.

Thanks — talk soon.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_summary_2026.pdf, HealthPrime_MAP_v1.docx
